evals.prompt: Create a user creation request DTO in a Java 17 Spring Boot project. Fields: userName (3-50 chars, required), email (required, valid email), phone (optional, 11 digits). The project already uses Lombok.
evals.expected_output: Use record to define the DTO with Bean Validation annotations, avoid Lombok @Data or @Builder
expectations: Uses record instead of Lombok class to define the DTO
userName field has @NotBlank and @Size annotations
email field has @NotBlank and @Email annotations
phone field has @Size or @Pattern annotation for 11-digit validation
Does not use @Data, @Getter, @Setter or other Lombok annotations

evals.prompt: Write a getUserById method for UserService that validates the id parameter, queries the Repository, and throws a business exception when not found. Use error code constants and support i18n. The project already has an ErrorCodes constants class and MessageSource.
evals.expected_output: Use guard clause validation, reference error codes via ErrorCodes constants, exception carries i18n message key and interpolation args
expectations: Method starts with guard clause validating id parameter (null and <= 0 check)
Validation failure throws ValidationException or IllegalArgumentException
User not found throws BusinessException
BusinessException error code referenced via ErrorCodes constants class, not inline string literal
Error code doubles as i18n message key; exception carries interpolation args
Exception message does not hardcode localized text

evals.prompt: Write a batch query method for an order service that retrieves orders by a list of user IDs. An existing single-query method selectByUserId(Long userId) exists. This method will be called in batch scenarios.
evals.expected_output: Provide a batch query method such as selectByUserIdIn, avoiding callers looping through single queries
expectations: Provides a batch query method instead of forcing callers to loop single queries
Method signature accepts Collection or List parameter
IN query ID list considers chunking or mentions chunking strategy
Returns List or Map rather than a single object
Query filters is_deleted = 0 by default

evals.expected_output: Identify field injection, printStackTrace, hardcoded error message, missing DTO validation, returning Entity directly, Controller try/catch, missing Javadoc
expectations: Identifies field injection @Autowired instead of constructor injection
Identifies e.printStackTrace() instead of using a logging framework
Identifies hardcoded error message in response body
Identifies Controller hand-writing try/catch instead of delegating to global exception handler
Identifies missing Request DTO and Bean Validation
Identifies returning Entity directly instead of Response DTO
Identifies missing class and method Javadoc

evals.expected_output: Rewrite using switch expression with arrow syntax, no fall-through risk, all branches covered
expectations: Uses switch expression (-> arrow syntax) instead of traditional switch statement
Each branch directly returns a value with no break statements
Covers default branch for unknown status
Method body is concise, leveraging switch expression for direct return

evals.prompt: Design a user shipping address table named address. Include address information fields and follow the project database standards.
evals.expected_output: CREATE TABLE statement with standard audit fields, NOT NULL constraints, utf8mb4 charset, logical deletion field
expectations: Includes id primary key BIGINT UNSIGNED
Includes create_user_id, update_user_id, create_time, update_time, is_deleted audit fields
All columns declared NOT NULL with sensible DEFAULT
Character set is utf8mb4
Business columns such as user_id have indexes
Table and column names use lowercase snake_case

evals.prompt: Write a batch order insertion Service method. An OrderMapper.batchInsert(List<Order>) method already exists. The project uses Spring Boot and needs configurable batch size support.
evals.expected_output: Use @ConfigurationProperties for batch size, partition and commit in chunks, execute within transaction
expectations: Batch size injected via configuration rather than hardcoded
Uses Lists.partition or equivalent to chunk data
Method annotated with @Transactional
Calls batchInsert instead of looping single inserts
Configuration properties class uses @ConfigurationProperties instead of @Value
